SURFACE_FILM_RULE.rule: a ray that enters a filled block from air crosses a film toned by the axis of the face it enters (T_a: x 128, y 0, z 255, the drawing's rule = the cube at the dial's end H = 1/2); behind it the first bar of the texture unit (its face's axis tone; a bar cut by the face takes T_a), counted only if its point lies in a filled block, else the bulk m(v) = round(sum|v_i| tone_i / sum|v_i|) (the block's three back faces by projected area, wf6/colour unitBulk); pixel = round((T_a + B)/2), Colour Middling's Average, two films (what lies behind the face weighs 1/2, wf6/colour's 2^-k).
SURFACE_FILM_RULE.palette_on_faces: 0, 64, 128, 192, 255 only FROM THE CRUX (m(v) = 128 there); from other views m(v) varies, so face colours are Average(T_a, m(v)) too: on the player views only 14-28% of face pixels are those five values (61-109 distinct values; check-solids check1.json)

TEXTURE_LEVEL_RULE.rule: the texture unit behind a face is the unit of side s = F(j) m, cells anchored at multiples of s from the world origin; s = the smallest Fibonacci number whose bars (0.1 s) are >= 8 px at the face's distance (phone focal 602.7 px: s = 1 to 7.5 m, 2 to 15.1, 3 to 22.6, 5 to 37.7, 8 to 60.3, 13 to 97.9, 21 to 158, 34 to 256, 55 to 414 m), stepped down until the s-cell at the face point is WHOLLY filled (full-cell rule; a summed-volume or per-level fullness texture: one fetch per level tried)
TEXTURE_LEVEL_RULE.consequence: bars stay 8-16 px, so the texture never closes on big masses; thin things (2 m walls, 1 m steps, 2 m-deep ground) keep the 1 m or 2 m unit; a cube of side F(k) is tiled exactly only by F(j) with j | k (F(j) divides F(k) iff j divides k): the F(8) = 21 cube takes 1, 3, 21 - at 21 its hexagon carries ONE figure (C3_cube21_texture_levels.png), the drawing closed in its own cube | check-solids: TRUE ONLY FOR A CUBE AT A WORLD CORNER that is a multiple of F(j) and seen on its far faces. The rule tests only the cell at the entry point (world-anchored), not whether the face is tiled: the same 21 cube from the opposite eye wears 3/5/8/13 m units on one face (K2_cube21_offset0_opposite_asked13.png); moved 1 block it wears 1/2 m, moved 5 blocks 1/2/13 m. The level is set by world position mod F(j), not by the cube. C3 panel 3 was the 3 m texture again (the full-cell rule dropped 8 -> 3); re-rendered with 8 m forced.

CUBE.rule: a cube of side F(k) blocks (k = 4, 6, 8: 3, 8, 21; levels phi^2 apart), every block the unit under the surface film; units per level F(k)^3 (27, 512, 9261), seen units = shell (26, 296, 2402)
CUBE.dial: the FIGURE thickened never reads as the hexagon of three rhombi (tone IoU 0.28 at H 1/9, 0.33 at 6H = 1, 0.47 at H 1/2: its outline stays a truncated triangle); the cube's 12 EDGES as bars do: silhouette IoU 0.924 (H 1/9) -> 0.998 at 6H = 1 (where the figure's holes close), tone IoU 0.59 / 0.75 / 0.958 (H 1/3) / 1.000 (H 1/2); the surface film is that end of the dial made a film (dial.json, C1_dial.png)
CUBE.four_tribars: the cube's 12 edges = 4 monotone paths, one per body diagonal: 18 ways; with the main diagonal's tribar the drawing's A (order y,x,z) 3; exactly one gives the other three one common order (z,x,y); none is 3-fold symmetric (tribars4.json)

PYRAMID.rule: a stepped pyramid of height F(k) blocks, layer j from the top a square of side 2j - 1 (one block in per layer: the smallest step the grid allows, slope 1:1); units sum (2j-1)^2 = h(4h^2-1)/3 = 35, 680, 12341; ideal = the pyramid of base 2h, height h (the steps' corners on it at mid-layer)

SPHERE.rule: the voxel sphere: a block is filled iff its centre lies within R = F(k) blocks (3, 8, 21); its 2R layers are Arnell's equal-height bands (equal area by Archimedes), each a ring of units; units 136, 2176, 39024 (shell 80, 632, 4464) | check-solids: the BUILT layers are not equal in area: exposed area per layer ranges 25% / 56% / 60% of its mean (R 3/8/21; end layers about half); equal area holds for the ideal sphere's bands only.
